285.lead: Over 35% of the ecoregion experiences flooding during the wet season (August – January).

421.name: Torngat Mountain tundra
421.lead: The mountains feature glacially carved U-shaped valleys and deep fjords.

782.name: Trans-Baikal Bald Mountain tundra
782.lead: Floral communities are those of mountain tundra, with bare rock or permafrost under layers of moss and lichen.

718.name: Trans-Baikal conifer forests
718.lead: Historically, the area has been called "Dauria", or Transbaikal ("the land beyond Lake Baikal").

559.name: Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt pine-oak forests
559.lead: The Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt pine–oak forests is a subtropical coniferous forest ecoregion of the Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt of central Mexico.

photo.by: Paco Olvera Monterd from Ciudad de Mexico D.F., México

188.name: Trans Fly savanna and grasslands
188.lead: With their monsoon and dry season climate these grasslands are quite different from the tropical rainforest that covers most of the island and resemble the landscape of northern Australia which lies to the south.

68.name: Tristan Da Cunha-Gough Islands shrub and grasslands
68.lead: The islands' remote location gave rise to many endemic species.
68.wiki: Tristan da Cunha–Gough Islands shrub and grasslands

158.name: Trobriand Islands rain forests
158.lead: The islands of this ecoregion have been separated from mainland New Guinea since the Late Pleistocene, and much of the biota is unique, including four mammal species and two birds-of-paradise plant species.

632.name: Tuamotu tropical moist forests
632.lead: The Tuamotu tropical moist forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in the Tuamotu Archipelago of French Polynesia and the Pitcairn Islands.

633.name: Tubuai tropical moist forests
633.lead: The Tubuai tropical moist forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in French Polynesia.

photo.by: Jérémie Silvestro (If you can improve this photo development

549.name: Tumbes-Piura dry forests
549.lead: The ecoregion contains many endemic species of flora and birds adapted to the short wet season followed by a long dry season.

806.name: Tyrrhenian-Adriatic sclerophyllous and mixed forests
806.lead: The ecoregion has a Mediterranean climate, and is in the Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub biome.

512.name: Ucayali moist forests
512.lead: The Ucayali moist forests (NT0174) is an ecoregion in the western Amazon rainforest of Peru.

photo.by: Venegas P, Torres-Carvajal O, Duran V, Queiroz K

287.name: Upper Gangetic Plains moist deciduous forests
287.lead: The Upper Gangetic Plains moist deciduous forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion of northern India.
287.wiki: Upper Gangetic Plains moist deciduous forests

574.name: Uruguayan savanna
574.lead: In Brazil, this ecoregion is known as Pampas.

685.name: Ussuri broadleaf and mixed forests
685.lead: The ecoregion is in the Palearctic realm, with a Humid Continental climate.

563.name: Valdivian temperate forests
563.lead: It is part of the Neotropical realm.

159.name: Vanuatu rain forests
159.lead: It is part of the Australasian realm, which includes neighboring New Caledonia and the Solomon Islands, as well as Australia, New Guinea, and New Zealand.

photo.by: Phillip Capper from Wellington, New Zealand

513.name: Venezuelan Andes montane forests
513.lead: It contains montane and cloud forests, reaching up to the high-level Cordillera de Merida páramo high moor ecoregion.

550.name: Veracruz dry forests
550.lead: They cover an area of 6600 km2.

photo.by: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

514.name: Veracruz moist forests
514.lead: The Veracruz moist forests  is a tropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in eastern Mexico.

photo.by: Carlos Adampol Galindo from DF, México

515.name: Veracruz montane forests
515.lead: It includes a belt of montane tropical forest on the eastern slope of the southern Sierra Madre Oriental and eastern Trans-Mexican Volcanic Belt ranges.

189.name: Victoria Plains tropical savanna
189.lead: The Victoria Plains tropical savanna is a tropical and subtropical grasslands, savannas, and shrublands ecoregion in northwestern Australia.

161.name: Vogelkop-Aru lowland rain forests
161.lead: The ecoregion covers the peninsular lowlands of western New Guinea, along with the Aru Islands and other nearby islands.

160.name: Vogelkop montane rain forests
160.lead: The ecoregion covers the mountains of western New Guinea's Bird's Head and Bomberai peninsulas.

368.name: Wasatch and Uinta montane forests
368.lead: The ecoregion was defined by the World Wildlife Fund, taken from an ecoregion defined by Omernik and used in the EPA ecoregion system.

846.name: West Saharan montane xeric woodlands
846.lead: Surrounded at lower elevations by the largely barren Sahara, the West Saharan montane xeric woodlands are isolated refuges of plants and animals that can survive in the higher humidity and lower temperatures of the highlands.

720.name: West Siberian taiga
720.lead: It is a vast, flat lowland region of boreal forests (taiga), and wetlands (40% of the region is swamps and bogs), covering an area about 1,800 km west–east, by 1,000 km north–south.

62.name: West Sudanian savanna
62.lead: The West Sudanian savanna is a tropical savanna ecoregion that extends across West Africa.

216.name: Western Australian Mulga shrublands
216.lead: It is one of Australia's two mulga ecoregions, characterized by dry woodlands of mulga trees (Acacia aneura and related species) interspersed with areas of grassland and scrub.

29.name: Western Congolian swamp forests
29.lead: Together with the adjacent Eastern Congolian swamp forests, it forms one of the largest continuous areas of freshwater swamp forest in the world.

516.name: Western Ecuador moist forests
516.lead: At one time this region contained dense forests with highly diverse flora and fauna, and many endemic species.

686.name: Western European broadleaf forests
686.lead: It comprises temperate broadleaf and mixed forests, that cover large areas of France, Germany and the Czech Republic and more moderately sized parts of Poland, Austria, Switzerland, Belgium and South Limburg (Netherlands).

344.name: Western Great Lakes forests
344.lead: It is within the temperate broadleaf and mixed forests biome of North America, as well as the southernmost areas of the boreal forest.

30.name: Western Guinean lowland forests
30.lead: It is centered on Liberia, with portions in surrounding countries.

384.name: Western Gulf coastal grasslands
384.lead: It is known in Louisiana as the "Cajun Prairie", Texas as "Coastal Prairie," and as the Tamaulipan pastizal  in Mexico.

769.name: Western Himalayan alpine shrub and meadows
769.lead: The Western Himalayan alpine shrub and meadows is a montane grasslands and shrublands ecoregion of Nepal, India, and Tibet, which lies between the tree line and snow line in the western portion of the Himalaya Range.
769.wiki: Western Himalayan alpine shrub and meadows

308.name: Western Himalayan broadleaf forests
308.lead: The Western Himalayan broadleaf forests is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forest ecoregion which is found in the middle elevations of the western Himalayas, including parts of Nepal, India, and Pakistan.

310.name: Western Himalayan subalpine conifer forests
310.lead: The Western Himalayan subalpine conifer forests is a temperate coniferous forests ecoregion of the middle and upper elevations of the western Middle Himalayas of Nepal, India, and Pakistan.

288.name: Western Java montane rain forests
288.lead: Several mammals and bird species are found only in this ecoregion, including the Javan mastiff bat (Otomops formosus) and the Volcano mouse (Mus vulcani).

289.name: Western Java rain forests
289.lead: There are a variety of forest types - evergreen, semi-evergreen, moist deciduous, and even some patches of freshwater swamp.

634.name: Western Polynesian tropical moist forests
634.lead: It includes Tuvalu, the Phoenix Islands in Kiribati, Tokelau, and Howland and Baker islands, which are possessions of the United States.

402.name: Western shortgrass prairie
402.lead: The Western short grasslands is a temperate grassland ecoregion of the United States.

687.name: Western Siberian hemiboreal forests
687.lead: It consists of a thin band of mixed forest along the southernmost edge of the West Siberian taiga (coniferous forests) in Western Siberia, and north of the forest steppe belt.
687.wiki: West Siberian broadleaf and mixed forests

180.name: Westland temperate forests
180.lead: These forests are found in the region of the Westland District, which spans approximately 11,880 square kilometers.

517.name: Windward Islands moist forests
517.lead: The forested areas are mostly at higher elevations in the interior of the islands, surrounded by dry forests, dry shrubland, or mangroves on the flat coastal lowlands.

438.name: Wyoming Basin shrub steppe
438.lead: The Wyoming Basin shrub steppe ecoregion, within the deserts and xeric shrublands biome, is a shrub steppe in the northwestern United States.

photo.by: US Department of Agriculture. Sam Cox

518.name: Xingu-Tocantins-Araguaia moist forests
518.lead: It is part of the Amazon biome.

784.name: Yamal-Gydan tundra
784.lead: This unique ecoregion is characterized by its sparsely populated vegetation and wildlife, yet it holds great significance as a vital haven for migratory birds and coastal sea mammals.

638.name: Yap tropical dry forests
638.lead: It includes the Yap Islands and neighboring atolls in the Federated States of Micronesia.

162.name: Yapen rain forests
162.lead: The ecoregion covers the island of Yapen and smaller neighboring islands which lie north of New Guinea.

748.name: Yellow Sea saline meadow
748.lead: The plants of the region are adapted to the wet, saline soils transitioning inland to fresh water arriving from the west.

551.name: Yucatán dry forests
551.lead: It includes the dry forests of the northwestern Yucatán Peninsula.

519.name: Yucatán moist forests
519.lead: It is found in the Yucatán Peninsula in southern Mexico, northern Guatemala, and small adjacent parts of extreme northern Belize.

643.name: Yunnan Plateau subtropical evergreen forests
643.lead: These forests once covered the western parts of the Yungui Plateau but have been significantly reduced and replaced with agricultural land uses.

688.name: Zagros Mountains forest steppe
688.lead: The ecoregion extends along the Zagros Mountains, stretching from eastern Turkey and northern Iraq to southern Iran.

64.name: Zambezian Baikiaea woodlands
64.lead: It includes dry deciduous forest and woodland, thicket, and grassland, dominated by the tree Baikiaea plurijuga.

75.name: Zambezian coastal flooded savanna
75.lead: It includes the coastal flooded savannas and grasslands in the deltas of the Zambezi, Pungwe, Buzi, and Save rivers.

photo.by: (c) Benjamin Fredlund, some rights reserved (CC BY)

42.name: Dry miombo woodlands
42.lead: It has an area of 1185632 km2, covering portions of Tanzania, Mozambique, Malawi, Zambia, Zimbabwe, and Angola.

33.name: Zambezian evergreen dry forests
33.lead: It consists of several areas of thick forest in western Zambia and adjacent Angola.

76.name: Zambezian flooded grasslands
76.lead: The Zambezian flooded grasslands is an ecoregion of southern and eastern Africa that is rich in wildlife.

65.name: Zambezian mopane woodlands
65.lead: The ecoregion is characterized by the mopane tree (Colophospermum mopane), and extends across portions of Botswana, Malawi, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, Eswatini, Zambia, and Zimbabwe, including the lower basins of the Zambezi and Limpopo rivers.

380.name: Northern Cordillera forests
380.lead: Northern Cordillera forests is a taiga ecoregion that extends across the northern interior of British Columbia, southern Yukon, and a small area of the Northwest Territories as defined by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) categorization system.

60.name: St. Helena scrub and woodlands
60.lead: The island's remote location gave rise to many endemic species.

photo.by: Dan Fulwiler - User: (WT-shared) Islandhopper at  wts wikivo

78.name: East African montane moorlands
78.lead: The East African montane moorlands is a montane grasslands and shrublands ecoregion which occupies several high mountain peaks in Kenya, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda.

381.name: Northwest Territories taiga
381.lead: It covers forest and tundra along the Mackenzie River Valley and the surrounding highlands in the southern portion of the valley.

107.name: Southwest Arabian coastal xeric shrublands
107.lead: It is classed as an Afrotropical fog desert

840.name: South Arabian plains and plateau desert
840.lead: The ecoregion has a total area of 37,328 km2.
840.wiki: South Arabian plains and plateau desert

809.name: Arabian desert
809.lead: It stretches from Yemen to the Persian Gulf and Oman to Jordan and Iraq.

552.name: Bahamian pineyards
552.lead: The Bahamian pineyards are a tropical and subtropical coniferous forest ecoregion in the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands.

photo.by:
Caleb Spiegel/USFWS
U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Northeast

96.name: Ile Europa and Bassas da India xeric scrub
96.lead: The island had never been inhabited until 1820, when the French family of Rosier moved to it.

773.name: Kamchatka tundra
773.lead: The region is one of volcanos, caldera, geysers, and mountain tundra.
773.wiki: Kamchatka mountain tundra and forest tundra

508.name: Tocantins/Pindare moist forests
508.lead: It is part of the Amazon biome.

361.name: Northern Rockies conifer forests
361.lead: This region overlaps in large part with the North American inland temperate rainforest and gets more rain on average than the South Central Rockies forests and is notable for containing the only inland populations of many species from the Pacific coast.

509.name: Trindade-Martin Vaz Islands tropical forests
509.lead: The archipelago has a total area of 10.4 km2 and a navy-supported research station of up to 8 persons.

59.name: Southwest Arabian montane woodlands and grasslands
59.lead: The Southwestern Arabian montane woodlands is a xeric woodland ecoregion in the southwestern Arabian Peninsula.

56.name: South Arabian fog woodlands, shrublands, and dune
56.lead: The fog woodlands lie on mountainsides which slope southeastwards towards the Arabian Sea.
56.wiki: South Arabian fog woodlands, shrublands, and dune

548.name: Trinidad and Tobago dry forest
548.lead: Tropical dry forests in Trinidad and Tobago include both deciduous and semi-evergreen forests.

537.name: Lesser Antillean dry forests
537.lead: These forests generally form a band around the interior wet forests of higher elevations, and because they are often flat, they are under the most pressure for human settlement and agriculture.

672.name: North Atlantic moist mixed forests
672.lead: It consists of maritime forests and heathlands on the western and northern coasts of Ireland, Scotland, and neighboring islands.

156.name: Sulawesi lowland rain forests
156.lead: The ecoregion includes the lowlands of Sulawesi and neighboring islands.

8.name: East African montane forests
8.lead: The ecoregion comprises several separate areas above 2000 meters in the mountains of South Sudan, Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania.

9.name: Eastern Arc forests
9.lead: The ecoregion comprises several separate highland areas above 800 meters in Kenya, and (mostly) Tanzania.

220.name: Borneo montane rain forests
220.lead: It includes montane tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests, also known as a cloud forests.

313.name: Kinabalu montane alpine meadows
313.lead: With a height of 13,435 ft, it is the third-highest peak of an island on Earth, the 28th-highest peak in Southeast Asia, and 20th-most-prominent mountain in the world.
